description_en: Adds one or more load balancing server groups to a scaling group. Supported server group types include Application Load Balancer (ALB) and Network Load Balancer (NLB)
description_zh: 从伸缩组添加一个或多个负载均衡服务器组，支持的服务器组类型包括：应用型负载均衡ALB (Application Load Balancer)、网络型负载均衡NLB (Network Load Balancer)
kebab_example: aliyun ess attach-server-groups --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --scaling-group-id asg-bp18p2yfxow2dloq0000 --server-group Type=ALB Port=22 ServerGroupId=sgp-60ofsqhwer0b000 Weight=100 --api-version 2014-08-28 --region cn-hangzhou
name: AttachServerGroups

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the scaling group
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the scaling group
parameters.name: scaling_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25965.html
parameters.help_zh:
保证请求幂等性。

从客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求之间，该参数值唯一。只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25965.html
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to add the existing ECS instances or Elastic Container Instance (ECI) instances in the scaling group to the new server group. Valid values:

true: Adds the instances.

false: Does not add the instances.

Default value: false
parameters.help_zh:
是否将当前伸缩组内的ECS实例或ECI实例添加到新增的服务器组。取值范围：

true：添加。

false：不添加。

默认值：false
parameters.name: force_attach

fields.help_en:
The port number used by an ECS instance or ECI instance after Auto Scaling adds the instance to the server group.

Valid values: 1 to 65535.

This parameter is required for ALB and NLB load balancing server groups. You cannot configure this parameter in Settings for GWLB load balancing server groups, and the default value is 6081
fields.help_zh:
弹性伸缩将ECS实例或ECI实例添加到服务器组后，ECS实例或ECI实例使用的端口号。

取值范围：1~65535。

ALB和NLB类型负载均衡该参数为必填参数，GWLB类型负载均衡不能设置该参数且默认值为6081
fields.name: port

fields.help_en: The ID of the load balancing server group
fields.name: server_group_id

fields.help_en:
The type of the load balancing server group. Valid values:

ALB: Application Load Balancer (ALB).
NLB: Network Load Balancer (NLB).
GWLB: Gateway Load Balancer (GWLB)
fields.help_zh:
负载均衡服务器组类型。取值范围：

ALB：应用型负载均衡ALB（Application Load Balancer）。
NLB：网络型负载均衡NLB（Network Load Balancer）。
GWLB: 网关型负载均衡 GWLB（Gateway Load Balancer）
fields.name: type

fields.help_en:
The weight of an ECS instance or ECI instance as a backend server after Auto Scaling adds the instance to the server group. Valid values: 0 to 100.

A higher weight indicates that the instance is allocated more access requests. If the weight is 0, the instance does not receive any access requests.

This parameter is required for ALB and NLB load balancing server groups. You cannot configure this parameter in Settings for GWLB load balancing server groups
fields.help_zh:
弹性伸缩将ECS实例或ECI实例添加到服务器组后，ECS实例或ECI实例作为后端服务器的权重。取值范围：0~100。

权重越高，ECS实例或ECI实例将被分配到越多的访问请求。如果权重为0，则ECS实例或ECI实例不会收到访问请求。

ALB和NLB类型负载均衡该参数为必填参数，GWLB类型负载均衡不能设置该参数
fields.name: weight

parameters.help_en: The information about the load balancing server groups
parameters.help_zh: 负载均衡服务器组的相关信息集合
parameters.name: server_group

ScalingActivityId.description_en:
The ID of the scaling activity that is triggered when the load balancing server group is added and the existing ECS instances or ECI instances in the scaling group are added to the server group.
This parameter is returned only when ForceAttach is set to true
ScalingActivityId.description_zh:
添加负载均衡服务器组并将伸缩组内的ECS实例或ECI实例添加到该服务器组时，伸缩活动的ID。
仅当`ForceAttach`取值为`true`时，返回该参数
